segments.title: An octopus has THREE hearts
segments.sub: And each one has **a different job**
segments.say: An octopus has three hearts. And each one has a different job.

segments.title: Two pump to the gills
segments.say: Two hearts push blood past the gills. The third heart pumps it to the rest of the body.

segments.title: Heart 3 stops when it swims
segments.say: And here's the weird part. That third heart stops beating when the octopus swims.

segments.title: Its blood is BLUE
segments.say: Its blood is blue, because it carries oxygen with copper, not iron.

segments.sub: to a friend who loves weird animal facts
segments.say: Send this to a friend who loves weird animal facts. Three hearts, or brains in your arms. Which is stranger?
